canonical_project: Star Joint Venture Co. / Pyongyang Internet Communication Bureau
owner: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (DPRK) / Loxley Pacific (Thailand) JV
notes: North Korea's sole internet service provider and international gateway, headquartered in Pyongyang; Pyongyang Internet Communication Bureau ground-breaking Nov 2015. Carries all DPRK international traffic via China Unicom (with Intelsat satellite and TransTeleCom backup links); houses the country's international gateway/server infrastructure. Telecommunication gateway facility rather than a commercial datacenter.
